root_cause_verification.r1_claim: Repair prompt in code_generator.py does not re-include FORBIDDEN DataSources constraint

exact_issue.description: pdf_pattern_reminder is built by filtering packet.constraints for REQUIRED patterns only. FORBIDDEN constraints (including 'FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources') are excluded from repair prompt.
exact_issue.consequence: LLM receives repair prompt with REQUIRED patterns but no FORBIDDEN constraints. LLM is free to re-introduce 'using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources;' during repair.
exact_issue.validate_code_blocks_it: Yes — _validate_code detects DataSources and blocks, but by then repair has already failed

initial_prompt_verification.constraint_text: FORBIDDEN: using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.DataSources — this sub-namespace does NOT exist. FileDataSource lives in Aspose.Pdf.LowCode. Use 'using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode;' only.
